title: March on the spot

steps.text: Stand tall and start marching on the spot.
Lift your knees to a comfortable height and put each foot down softly.
steps.cue: Knees to a comfortable height. Soft feet.

steps.text: Bend your elbows and swing your arms in time with your legs.
steps.cue: Elbows bent. Arms swing in time.

steps.text: You should be able to talk, but feel warmer and breathe a little faster.
steps.cue: You can still talk, and you feel warmer.

mistakes: Leaning back as the knees come up.
regression: Take smaller steps, or sit on a sturdy chair and march your feet.
stopIf: Stop if you feel dizzy, sick, very short of breath, or any pain in your chest.

anatomy.why: Lifting the knees in turn keeps the big leg muscles busy, which gently raises your breathing.
